text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While Mejiro Bright awaits her own<n>debut, Mejiro
Dober continues to<n>train for her next race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright notices the change in<n>Mejiro Dober
after her debut, and<n>they make a promise to forge
new<n>Mejiro legacies together.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Under the setting sun, Mejiro Dober<n>swears to
compete in the Triple Tiara<n>and Mejiro Bright in the
Classic<n>Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In order to prepare for the Triple Tiara,<n>Mejiro
Dober decides to run in the<n>Hanshin Juvenile Fillies
first!
